The '''Vanquisher''' [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] was occasionally used by the students of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]], although it resembled the weapons of [[Exar Kun's lightsaber/Legends|Exar Kun]] and [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Unlike the [[Guardian (hilt)|Guardian]], [[Champion (hilt)|Champion]], and [[Vindicator (hilt)|Vindicator]] hilts, Vanquisher was forged as a single unit, with the main body thicker than the ends in order to give the wielder more stability.
